$comment: S02 Episode 2 narration, ENGLISH track. Added 2026-08-11 per user request - on-screen text is already English (matching S01's convention), so narration should have an English option too, alongside the Russian track in lines.json (user: 'Russian voice is good, by the way' - this is an addition, not a replacement). Same line ids as lines.json so timing.ts's cue names map 1:1 if this track is selected instead.
$modelNote: multilingual_v2 has NO audio-tag support (see docs/VOICE.md's fallback note) - bracketed tags like [matter-of-fact] get READ ALOUD, not consumed as direction. Confirmed 2026-08-11 when n10 first shipped with a tag and Scribe transcribed 'Matter of fact...' as spoken words. Do not add audio tags to this file.
$casting: Single speaker, no cast, matching lines.json's narrator role. Voice: River - Relaxed, Neutral, Informative (en, American, neutral gender) - picked over more 'engaging/enthusiast' options specifically because docs/VOICE.md's lesson from ep01 is that an expressive tag/voice reads as amused rather than flat; River's own label already leans neutral/informative, closest English analogue to Marina's suppressed-warmth recipe.

narrator.note: Documentary/textbook register, same brief as the Russian track's narrator: explains, never dramatizes, no reaction to on-screen events beyond stating what they mean.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everything used to live in one place.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every application talked to the hardware directly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One job, pulled out. One stable line left in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then: where does the data live?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then: how does a person actually use it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The same move, three times over. Pull the function out, keep one stable line back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Different departments. Different copies of the same fact.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Change one, and the other two don't know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One shared database. One version of the truth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The same move as the operating system. Just at a different scale.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then new systems arrive. From other vendors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The same silo problem. One level up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Six systems. Fifteen connections. Every new system adds more wiring than the last one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The same six systems. Now, one shared hub.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The dependency didn't disappear. It moved inside the hub.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every fix so far has only moved where the coupling lives. None of them made the process itself visible.
